header.function_name: X2 Crossdock Master Setting - Part List Upload

objective: To process the Part List file uploaded from the Crossdock Master Setting - Part List screen: from the [Validate file] button of the Upload Excel modal until the data is saved to TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE.
In case any error occurs, nothing is saved to the master. The error is recorded in the upload log and a result report is created.

inputs.name: Part List file (sheet Upload)
inputs.description: Uploaded by the user on the Part List screen ([Validate file]). Only sheet Upload is read. Max 5 MB, 5,000 rows.

inputs.name: TB_M_PART_MASTER
inputs.description: Part existence check and Part Name

inputs.name: TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE
inputs.description: Current data for duplicate check, status rule and Edit comparison

inputs.name: TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE_DEST
inputs.description: Total Case/Day already mapped per part in the ongoing calculation period (check 9)

outputs.name: TB_H_PART_CANDIDATE
outputs.description: if successful: history record per changed field of each saved part

outputs.name: Log
outputs.description: Upload log: one record per upload with status (COMPLETED / REJECTED), counts and errors

outputs.name: Result report
outputs.description: Also if error occurs. Sheets: Summary, Result, Re-upload, Changes

rows: Starts when the user clicks [Validate file] in the Upload Excel modal of the Part List screen (on demand, no schedule).

steps: User clicks [Validate file] in the Upload Excel modal of the Part List screen. The batch starts and receives the uploaded file.

steps.text: Check the file: format .xlsx, size, number of rows, sheet "Upload" and template columns (see 4.1).
children: If the file is not valid, reject the upload and go to step 7.

steps.text: Check every row against the business rules (see 4.2) and collect all errors.
children: Each row is Add (flag A) or Edit (flag E).

steps.text: If any row has an error, reject the whole file. Nothing is saved to the master and the errors are recorded in the upload log.
If all rows are valid, save to master table TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE (see 4.3).
children: Add: register the new part as Candidate.
Edit: update the changed values, including status Active <-> Inactive. A row with no change is skipped.
Every saved part gets Sync Status = No Sync.

steps: Create the result report and record the result (completed or rejected) in the upload log. The Part List screen shows the result to the user. Exit.

func_desc.text: This batch starts when the user clicks [Validate file] in the Upload Excel modal of the Part List screen. It checks the uploaded file and, if everything is valid, saves the data to TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE. If not, the upload is rejected and recorded in the upload log.

items: Only sheet "Upload" of the file is read. Parts that are not in the sheet are not changed.
One run saves all rows or none (all-or-nothing).
Part Name is retrieved from TB_M_PART_MASTER. Total Pcs/Day is calculated as Pcs/Case x Max Case/Day. Both are saved.
File size is 5 MB or less.
Sheet Upload has 1 to 5,000 data rows.
Sheet "Upload" exists. Other sheets are ignored.
Header has the 7 template columns (see Appendix). Extra columns are ignored.

func_desc.text: Every row is checked and all errors are collected, so the user can correct the file once.

items: If any row is rejected, nothing is saved to TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE. The upload status and the error of every row are recorded in the upload log (Log).

If all rows are valid, the data is saved to TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE: flag A inserts a new part (status Candidate), flag E updates the changed values, including status Active <-> Inactive. Rows with no change are skipped.
The status of a Candidate part is changed only in the Edit part data modal on the screen, not by upload.
Every inserted or changed part gets a history record per changed field in TB_H_PART_CANDIDATE (event ADD / EDIT, source UPLOAD, UPLOAD_ID of this run; refer Appendix).
Every saved record gets Sync Status = No Sync. It is sent to the global system by the RPA when D/S clicks [Sync] in Mapping per Destination.
A result report (.xlsx) is created for both cases.

rows: Flag A: Part No is not yet in TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE. Flag E: it already is.
Part No appears only once in the file.
Min MAD is a whole number, 0 or more, and Pcs/Case and Max Case/Day are whole numbers greater than 0; all three are required on every row.

Status: flag A must be blank (a new part is always Candidate). Flag E: a Candidate part must stay Candidate (blank or Candidate); an Active part may be changed to Inactive and an Inactive part to Active; no part can be changed to Candidate.
Effective Start Date is required when the part status is Candidate (always for flag A) and must be today or later when new or changed.
Flag E: Effective Start Date can only change while the part status is Candidate.

Flag E: Max Case/Day is not below the total Case/Day already mapped per destination in the ongoing calculation period of Mapping per Destination (TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE_DEST) (e.g. mapped 100, new Max Case/Day 80 is rejected). The user must first reduce the mapping in the Mapping per Destination sub-menu, then lower Max Case/Day in Part List.

tables.name: TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE
tables.description: Candidate part setting, one record per part (Part List data, no calculation period). Target of a successful upload.
columns: Minimum MAD (mandatory); reference compared with the MAD result of the calculation
Effective start date; required while the part is Candidate
Date-time of the last RPA result
Reason of the last Failed sync
Upload that last changed the record
User who last changed the record

tables.name: TB_H_PART_CANDIDATE
tables.description: History of every change of a crossdock part (Add / Edit by screen or upload, mapping changes, Sync results, status changes and mappings made by the calculation batches). Read by the History setting modal of Part List (index PART_NO, CREATED_DT). Proposed retention: 24 months online by CREATED_DT; a monthly housekeeping job deletes older records (period configurable in system master). To be confirmed.
columns: Calculation period YYYYMM for MAPPING / SYNC / CALC; NULL for ADD / EDIT (Part List has no period)
Upload of the change (Log); NULL when not from an upload
Destination code (7 digits) for MAPPING; NULL for other events
Changed field: PCS_CASE, MAX_CASE_DAY, MIN_MAD, PART_STATUS, EFFECTIVE_START_DATE, CASE_DAY, SYNC_STATUS
Value before the change; NULL for ADD or an added destination
Value after the change; NULL for a removed destination
Free text, e.g. SYNC_MESSAGE of a Failed sync
User who made the change (RPA user ID for SYNC, batch user ID for BATCH)
Date and time of the change
